defs.def: to have a particular smell 有（或发出）… 气味

ex.s: Your cat will likely smell your face and store the smell in its memory and use it to recognize you in the future.
ex.t: 你的猫可能会闻到你的脸，并将气味存储在它的记忆中，并在将来用它来识别你。

ex.s: “And therefore, the perception of how the forest smells changes.”
ex.t: 这种影响不仅限于森林。

ex.s: It smells too strong and it tastes a bit sour.
ex.t: 闻起来太浓了，味道有点酸。

ex.s: Warmer conditions can intensify smells, leading the snow to smell more unpleasant and potentially gather more pollutants.
ex.t: 气候变化也在加速生物多样性的丧失，威胁要彻底消除某些气味。

ex.s: It reminded me of blue cheese, a similarly strong smelling type o food you either love or hate.
ex.t: 它让我想起蓝纹奶酪，一种气味同样浓烈、让人爱憎分明的食物。

ex.s: “Our roads smell like Wisconsin!” he said.
ex.t: “我们的道路闻起来像威斯康星州！”他说。

defs.def: to notice or recognize a particular smell 不用于进行时；常与 can 或 could 连用
to be able to notice and recognize smells 不用于进行时，常与 can 或 could 连用
to put your nose near sth and breathe in so that you can discover or identify its smell 通常不用于被动语态
to have an unpleasant smell 不用于进行时
to feel that sth exists or is going to happen 觉察出；感觉到

ex.s: A: How does it look/smell/taste/feel?
ex.t: 答：它看起来/闻起来/味道/感觉如何？

ex.s: B: It looks/smells/tastes/feels...
ex.t: B ：看起来/闻起来/味道/感觉……

defs.def: to be aware of fear, danger, trouble, etc. in a situation 觉察到，意识到（坏事、危险、麻烦等）
to find sth by smelling 嗅出；闻出

ex.s: Nick has a fun time smelling the leaves and running after rabbits.
ex.t: 尼克闻着树叶、追着兔子，玩得很开心。

defs.def: the quality of sth that people and animals sense through their noses 气味

ex.s: Walking through the streets of Brooklyn today, I am no longer confused by this city’s sounds and smells.
ex.t: 今天走在布鲁克林的街道上，我不再对这个城市的声音和气味感到困惑。

ex.s: But smell is often overlooked and undervalued.
ex.t: 但嗅觉常常被忽视和低估。

ex.s: However, a strong smell is added so that we can raise the alarm when we detect the smell associated with danger.
ex.t: 然而，会加入一种强烈的气味，这样当我们察觉到与危险相关的气味时就能发出警报。

ex.s: Then she caught the smell of burning.
ex.t: 平底锅里的那片面包也变黑了。

ex.s: Back in 1983, two scientists, Jack Schultz and Ian Baldwin, reported that young maple trees getting bitten by insects send out a particular smell that neighboring plants can get.
ex.t: 早在1983年，两位科学家杰克·舒尔茨和伊恩·鲍德温报告说，被昆虫叮咬的幼枫树会发出一种特殊的气味，邻近的植物能够接收到。

ex.s: Disappearance of the Earth’s smells can be a cultural loss.
ex.t: 地球气味的消失可能是一种文化上的损失。

ex.s: Loss of smells can lead to natural disasters.
ex.t: 气味景观的损害可以被人工修复。

ex.s: By checking on smells.
ex.t: 通过检查气味。

ex.s: Why do humans prefer some smells over others?
ex.t: 为什么人类偏好某些气味而不是其他的？

ex.s: Forest smell is likely to be changed by perception.
ex.t: 地球气味的消失可能是一种文化损失。

defs.def: an unpleasant smell 难闻的气味；臭味

ex.s: Smell changes of forest and snow share a common underlying cause.
ex.t: 森林和雪的气味变化有一个共同的深层原因。

ex.s: Climate change is also quickening the loss of biodiversity, threatening to erase certain smells entirely.
ex.t: 当植物消失时，它们的气味变得更加难以产生。

ex.s: A recent study reported that native communities in Peru noticed a change in the smell of the Amazon River due to industrial pollution.
ex.t: 最近一项研究报告称，秘鲁的原住民社区注意到由于工业污染，亚马逊河的气味发生了变化。

ex.s: Cheese brine has a downside too a smell similar to that of bad milk.
ex.t: 奶酪卤水也有缺点——一种类似变质牛奶的气味。

ex.s: However, another way the cats are able to distinguish between situations is by looking for familiar smells.
ex.t: 不过，猫还能通过寻找熟悉的气味来区分不同的情况，这是它们的另一种方式。

ex.s: It was August, so it was really, really hot and it smelled so bad everywhere!
ex.t: 那是八月，所以天气非常非常热，到处闻起来都很难闻！

defs.def: the ability to sense things with the nose 嗅觉

ex.s: Smells are all around us.
ex.t: 气味无处不在。

ex.s: Cats have many heightened senses, but their sense of smell is quite impressive.
ex.t: 猫的许多感官都很敏锐，但它们的嗅觉尤其出色。

defs.def: the act of smelling sth 嗅；闻

ex.s: As Elli and I cooked dinner，a young male polar bear who was playing in a nearby lake sniffed，and smelled our garlic bread.
ex.t: 当埃利和我做晚饭时，一只在附近湖里玩耍的年轻雄性北极熊嗅了嗅，闻到了我们的蒜香面包。

ex.s: To make them smell better.
ex.t: 让它们闻起来更好。

chunks.cn: 闻脸 / 闻添加 / 闻味道 / 闻类型 / 闻强壮的 / 闻带领 / 闻改变 / 闻离开
